name: leadlyze
description: Review leads, contacts, companies and sales pipeline in your connected LeadLyze workspace.

defaultPrompt: Review my sales pipeline and suggest next steps.
Find leads matching my target industry and location.
Show contacts and companies in my connected workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect your LeadLyze workspace to review leads, contacts, companies and deals. Create or update CRM records when authorized. OAuth consent selects the workspace and tool categories; each call enforces the connection permissions. Requires a LeadLyze account.

positive.prompt: Show the first page of leads in my LeadLyze workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: List only authorized leads and disclose pagination.

positive.prompt: Show my contacts and summarize available details.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize returned contacts without inventing missing fields.
List bounded company records from the authorized workspace.

positive.prompt: Show my deals and summarize their stages.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize actual stages, values and currencies without changing records.

positive.prompt: Search my contacts for a company name I provide.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the supplied search query and report returned matches only.

negative.prompt: Show private leads in a workspace I have not authorized.
Summarize my leads. Do not email or call anyone.
Transfer money from my bank account.
